An '''[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]]''' was held under arrest by [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]] during the latter's [[Ghost Prison incident|military coup]] against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. During his time under Gentis' thumb, Gentis attempted to recruit him into his coup, citing the [[Imperial Crematorium]] building as the place where he began to decide to overthrow Palpatine.

After learning about the motives behind Gentis' revolt, he joined the group. He then learned from Gentis the existence of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] was more than rumor via a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]].

He was eventually executed by Palpatine after the latter returned and the coup ended.
